notes.title: New Game Release: Red Spider:Vengeance Remastered Is Out!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27029742/a50d8f1b46cccb596091cde02d70ba339786a852.jpg"][/img]Thank you for your patience! We're excited to announce that Red Spider:Vengeance Remastered, the first title in the series, is officially released today, September 15th.[/p][p]We've completely overhauled the graphics, re-recorded some of the voices, and made detailed revisions to the text and the "CYCLOPEDIA" feature. We've put a lot of work into this to give you a deeper and more immersive experience.[/p][p]The game's full story is completely free to play. We invite you to dive into the world of the new Red Spider![/p][p]You can find the store page here:[/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3582550/Red_Spider/" style="button"]Red Spider:Vengeance Remastered[/url][/p]

notes.title: “Red Spider Anecdote: The Longest Nite” will be released on December 24!
notes.notes:
The latest in the “Red Spider”series of Hong Kong noir novel games, “Red Spider Anecdote: The Longest Nite”is scheduled for release in December 24.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27029742/c13533237d16c668093913acbb6fc36b4069dce7.jpg[/img]
The hard-boiled story takes place in Thailand in 2009.
It is a full-voice work with all-new graphics.
Music is by Yasunori Shiono and Yukio Nakajima.
Please add it to your wish list.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3355700/_/]Steam Store[/url]

Character introductions and a sample corner of the original soundtrack are available on the official website.
[url=https://www.rpgdl.org/rscane/]Official Website[/url]

notes.title: We have entered the Steam Greenlight process with new game
notes.notes:
We've entered the Steam Greenlight process with "Red Spider Anecdote: Triangle".
This is an anecdote of "Red Spider: Vengeance", takes place 3 years before Francis has been shot.

Due to a shortage of budget, only Japanese version is available.
If you may, please give us your vote and wish us luck.

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=863342456
